mount_point.description: Path where the loggedfs virtual filesystem will be mounted.

logging.description: Central logging configuration. Enable logging, specify output file, and choose format.

enabled.description: Enable or disable logging to a file.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file.

format.description: Log format. 'json' recommended for structured analysis.

default.description: Log all file operations in home directories

rules.description: List of paths and operation modes to monitor. Each rule can be recursive and define custom actions.

path.description: Filesystem path to monitor (supports glob patterns like /home/*).

mode.description: Which operations to log: read, write, or all.

recursive.description: Apply rule recursively to all subdirectories.

description.description: Human-readable description of this rule (for documentation).

actions.description: List of actions to take for matching events (e.g., write to custom log).

type.description: Event type to trigger this action.

target.description: Optional custom log file path for this action. If omitted, uses default log file.

allow_user.description: Unix username allowed to control loggedfs (e.g., via signals). Leave blank for none.

allow_group.description: Unix group allowed to control loggedfs. Leave blank for none.

max_log_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per log file before rotation. Default: 10 MB.

log_rotation_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain. Older files are deleted.

buffer_size.description: Size of in-memory buffer (in bytes) used before flushing to disk.
